title: The Envious Man and the Envied

new_assets.name: person costume presets (sultan, princess, jinn pair)

plan_warnings: Many assets here are planned names from other stories (person costume layer, village, countryRoad, palaceHall, iconBalloon, thoughtCloud, dayCycle, inset circle, flush, spiralEyes, windSpirit, oilLamp, rope, purse, bindle, runInPlace, person kneel/sit). If they are not in Library when this film is built, they must be built here first: the total drawing load is then large (L).
Five sets and thirteen cast entries is a lot for 170 s; the people are all one figure with costumes, which keeps it feasible.
Only eight narration pauses exist, so the shove, the spirit exit and the rescue have no sound effect; they must read from picture alone.
The LATER... card overlaps the first two words of paragraph 6 (106.36 to about 107.9); the sultan entrance is cued at 108.6 so nothing is hidden.
S11 and S12 hold one cutaway for 24 s; the balloons, the two jinn acting and the listening man must keep something changing every 1-2 s.
